Thanks for the context. Recommendations from legal:
1) DocuSign routing: add Mia Chen as Signer #1 and Aaron Patel as Signer #2 in the routing order, but configure Aaron as an "Alternate" recipient (DocuSign term: "Signer is an alternate") so he only gets a signing invite if Mia declines or does not complete after X days.
